visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a black pot on a stove, containing a simmering vegetable soup with cabbage, tomatoes, and leeks. A pair of hands enters the frame to squeeze a sachet of miso paste into the pot. The kitchen background is bright with white tiles. (2) The hands use black chopsticks to stir the miso into the soup, ensuring it dissolves evenly. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a nearby window. (3) A plastic container filled with chopped green onions is held over the pot, and the onions are pushed into the soup using chopsticks. The soup now appears to have tofu cubes added. (4) The scene cuts to a black frying pan where oil is poured, followed by a large bag of fresh bean sprouts being emptied into it. The hands stir-fry the sprouts vigorously. (5) Two servings of stir-fried bean sprouts are shown on plates on a wooden table. In the background, a large window reveals a sprawling urban cityscape under a clear blue sky. (6) A bowl of purple multi-grain rice is shown, and chopped green onions are sprinkled on top. (7) A small container of natto (fermented soybeans) is prepared. The hands use chopsticks to whisk the beans until they become sticky and stringy. (8) The natto is poured over the rice bowl, followed by a single raw egg yolk placed carefully in the center. (9) The hands are shown assembling a hand-roll using a sheet of dried nori seaweed and fresh lettuce. (10) The final scene displays a carton of Yotsuba milk and a container of Yotsuba yogurt on the table next to the meal.

(2) A crinkling sound of plastic packaging is followed by the rhythmic scraping of chopsticks against a metal surface as the miso paste is integrated. (3) The acoustic landscape shifts to a loud, high-frequency sizzling sound as bean sprouts are added to a hot pan, which continues for several seconds. (4) Soft rustling and a quiet 'pop' of a container opening occur, followed by a thick, wet squelching sound of natto being stirred rapidly with chopsticks. (5) The music continues at a steady pace, overlapping with the sound of a ceramic bowl being set on a table and the final assembly of the meal.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's return to Tokyo from Hokkaido and their focus on preparing a healthy, vegetable-rich meal. It serves as a lifestyle vlog and a quick cooking tutorial, showcasing easy-to-make Japanese domestic dishes.
